product_one_liner.value: Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that helps developers and platform teams provision, govern, and operate cloud infrastructure through infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, and automated Day 2 workflows.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 164 employees; the official careers page also states 130+ co-workers.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts describe Spacelift’s own Kubernetes worker operator architecture (Adam Connelly, January 30, 2024) and backend migration to AWS Lambda (Jacob Martin, June 14, 2022). Their author biographies identify them as engineers at Spacelift.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes getting started, stack configuration, worker pools, security, and AI integrations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists eight openings; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude via Amazon Bedrock for Spacelift-hosted AI; customer-configured integrations also support Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 10, 2025 Series C falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live opening: Enterprise Account Executive (remote US, Texas).

launched_6mo.notes: The October 29, 2026 announcement introduces Spacelift Flows for event-driven Day 2 operations, with a visual canvas, execution replay, integrations, and approval gates; it falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 5, 2026, Spacelift announced John Henry Archer as SVP of Sales and Channel and Jonah Kowall as SVP of Product and Design, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is named in a live sales posting. HubSpot, Clay, Chili Piper, and Outreach appear in an archived marketing-operations posting. The published subprocessor inventory identifies HubSpot for marketing, Salesforce for CRM, Outreach and Apollo.io for sales support, and Segment as a customer-data platform. A supplier case study documents Labra for AWS co-selling automation. These are public stack signals, not a guarantee that every system remains in use.
